Subject: Monthly inference dashboard & leadership follow-ups (June)

Team — attaching the June dashboard and a brief headliner so leadership can scan quickly. Attaching: 2026-06-monthly-kpi-dashboard.pdf and a small CSV with per-region latency. High level: 

- Latency: p50 78ms (flat MoM), p95 420ms (up 8% driven by a spike on 6/3)
- Cost: $0.042 / 1k tokens (effective, but +12% vs May due to model mix and burst capacity)
- Uptime: 99.97% (one 18-minute regional incident on 2026-06-03 caused a dip)
- Usage: +24% MAU for hosted API; embeddings steady; dedicated throughput up 15%

Quick asks: 
1) Can leadership approve a one-time 5% operations budget buffer to cover burst capacity while we complete model packing and quantization rollouts? (see Cost section, page 4)
2) Approve canary of 4-bit quantized variant for internal test traffic next week (owner: Rishi).

Known open items 
- Root cause analysis for 6/3 regional outage: networking throttling on cluster ingress (prelim). We've opened SUP-4321.
- Need per-region p95 breakdown (Laura requested) — sending CSV attached.

Next steps: I'm scheduling a 30-min sync for Monday to walk the dashboard and align owners. If you want this shifted earlier, shout.

Attachments: 2026-06-monthly-kpi-dashboard.pdf (PDF, 2.6MB), latency-per-region.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Inference Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — short update and owners below. I've also uploaded the one-page summary to Drive and created SUP-4321 for postmortem tracking. Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=monthly-kpi-june-2026; Jira SUP-4321.

Per-region p95 (quick table):
- us-west: 380ms (primary culprit of the spike; ingress throttling observed)
- us-east: 410ms (normal variability)
- eu-west: 450ms (minor config mismatch; patch applied)
- apac: 520ms (single noisy node during maintenance window)

6/3 incident summary (2 lines): ingress rate limiter tripped due to an unexpected traffic pattern from a partner test; impact = 18 mins of elevated p95 and a handful of failed connections for a small % of requests. Mitigation: rate-limit thresholds relaxed and autoscaler adjusted; long-term fix = change request routing + better ingress backpressure (ETA: 2 weeks).

Canary plan (Rishi): 4-bit quantized variant on internal traffic only (10% of internal test shard, seeded 1k rps) for 72 hours; rollback triggers: p95 > baseline +20% OR accuracy regression on eval suite > 1.5% absolute. Rishi, please confirm readiness and the post-canary report template (peak throughput, p95, token cost delta, eval pass rate).

Cost buffer: added line items to page 5; split by Hosted/Dedicated and model family. Markus, forwarding deck update.

Action items (owners):
- Rishi: run canary and deliver post-canary report (due 2026-06-18)
- Tessa: coordinate finance approval for 5% buffer (submit by EOD Fri)
- Laura: draft exec note for QBR with the 6/3 summary (ETA: Mon EOD)
- Eng (assigned in SUP-4321): final fix for ingress routing (ETA: 2026-06-26)

Attachments: 2026-06-monthly-kpi-dashboard.pdf (updated, page 5 includes cost split)

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Inference Ops
